falseSynonyms.zh: 正好不等於大約 exactly 表示完全精確，和 approximately 的意思相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Exactly 100 people attended. Approximately 100 people attended.

falseSynonyms.zh: 精確地不等於大約 precisely 強調沒有誤差；approximately 容許一定誤差。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The distance is precisely 10 kilometres. It is approximately 10 kilometres.

falseSynonyms.zh: 幾乎不等於大約 almost 通常表示接近但尚未達到某個數值。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Almost 100 people means fewer than 100. About 100 may be slightly below or above 100.

falseSynonyms.zh: 至少不等於大約 at least 表示數量不低於某個值，而不是估計值。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON At least 50 people attended. About 50 people attended.

falseSynonyms.zh: 最多不等於大約 at most 表示數量不超過某個值。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON At most 20 people can enter. Around 20 people are expected.

falseSynonyms.zh: 超過不等於大約 over 表示明確高於某個數字。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Over 1,000 people attended. Roughly 1,000 people attended.

falseSynonyms.zh: 少於不等於大約 under 表示明確低於某個數字。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Under 30 minutes means less than 30 minutes. About 30 minutes allows some variation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞與副詞不同 approximation 是名詞；approximately 是副詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The figure is an approximation. The figure is approximately 500.
